ev.q: Higher rates of continuation were observed with self-administered DMPA-SC than with provider-administered DMPA
The new U.S. SPR recommendation states that self-administered DMPA-SC should be made available

methods_quotes.q: Meta-analyses were conducted when multiple studies reported the same outcome.
Risk of bias was evaluated using The Cochrane Collaboration tool for RCTs and the Evidence Project tool for observational studies.
